source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.teacher_note: Rate is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Can the learner choose multiplication for repeated decimal quantities' is answered as rate rather than equal groups.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Rate is what produces equal groups, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Can the learner choose multiplication for repeated.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: equal groups is settled by running 'Can the learner divide a whole number or decimal by 10, 100, 1000, and': To divide by 10, 100, 1000, and so on, move the decimal point left by the number of zeroes — on the item about Can the learner choose multiplication for repeated.

intelligence.enrichment: Equal groups of a decimal amount are found by multiplication; decimal multiplication can represent repeated addition, rate multiplied by amount, or length multiplied by breadth.
